title: Moving a test bench

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The bench passed its test this morning. It moves to Bay Four after lunch. Leave the reference block for the other team?
turns.zh: 測試臺早上通過檢查。午餐後搬到四號區。把基準塊留給另一組嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Take it with the bench. Another block could change the reading, and I need to compare readings before and after the move.
turns.zh: 讓它跟測試臺一起搬。換一塊可能改變讀值，而我得比對搬動前後的讀值。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’ll leave a spare. Send the bench straight to Bay Four, but pack the block in its padded case.
turns.zh: 我會留一塊備用的。測試臺直接搬去四號區，但基準塊要裝進有襯墊的盒子。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’ll bring the case. I’ve noted this morning’s reading for comparison.
turns.zh: 我會帶盒子。早上的讀值我已記下來，供比對。
